result.detail: Harvest docs: self-serve OAuth2 app registration in Harvest ID Developers section (name, redirect URL, multi-account, products). Users authorize via Authorization Code or Implicit flow. Personal Access Tokens also self-created. Docs mention no review, approval, listing, or install/user cap for unreviewed apps. Caveat: docs silent rather than explicit "no review needed"; Harvest ID developer terms not checked.
result.quote: If you are interested in building integrations that other users can use, you will need to register an OAuth2 Application, also known as an OAuth2 Client.
